evals.name: default-label-state-machine
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call the tracker. Triage issue 42 in a default Jira setup with no jira-mapping.md. It is ready for an agent.
evals.expected_output: Use the original category/state labels, default AI disclaimer, complete ticket-body brief, readiness comment, and original state machine.
assertions: Uses exactly one category label and ready-for-agent state label through triage-labels.md.
Uses the original default disclaimer and complete ready brief behavior.
Does not look for or require a generalized adapter.

evals.name: one-sparse-triage-override
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira. jira-mapping.md contains only triage.state.ready-for-agent mapped to existing status Verification. Category bug and every other role are absent from the sparse mapping. Describe triage of a verified bug to ready-for-agent.
evals.expected_output: Use Verification only for ready-for-agent, while keeping the default bug label, brief, comments, and all other label mappings unchanged.
assertions: Consults only the exact ready-for-agent row and applies its existing status operation.
Keeps the default bug label and does not infer status mappings for other roles.
Preserves the original verification, brief, and comment semantics.

evals.name: unrelated-mapping-does-not-switch-triage
evals.prompt: Source evaluation only; do not call Jira. jira-mapping.md contains one wayfinder.blocking override and no triage rows. Show the needs-info triage operation.
evals.expected_output: Ignore the unrelated Wayfinder row and use the original needs-info label operation.
assertions: Does not treat mapping-file presence as a tracker-wide mode switch.
